message: Last winter, we had a big snowstorm predicted, and I decided to turn the whole thing into a cozy event. I baked a batch of cookies, put on some old movies, and made sure we had enough blankets to build a fort. When the snow started swirling outside, we were all snug as bugs inside, sipping hot cocoa and laughing about how we were basically ‘snowed in’ at a five-star resort. Sometimes, a storm can be the perfect excuse to hunker down and spend quality time together. What’s your favorite way to make the most of a stormy day? ☕️
